cases.prompt: A Go queue consumer debited a wallet twice when the message was redelivered after a lost ack.
cases.reason: The failure is a duplicate durable effect across acknowledgment loss.

cases.prompt: Our order transaction commits but publishing OrderCreated sometimes fails. Design a Go outbox relay.
cases.reason: The task coordinates database state and asynchronous publication.

cases.prompt: A goroutine blocks forever sending to an unbuffered channel after its consumer returns.
cases.reason: This is in-process goroutine lifecycle, owned by go-concurrency-lifecycle.

cases.prompt: Configure TLS certificates and SASL authentication for a new Kafka client.
cases.reason: Transport bootstrap alone does not require delivery-semantics design.

cases.prompt: Implement an at-least-once Go consumer that inserts a ledger entry and acknowledges the message.
criteria: Uses one durable identity for deduplication under a database constraint.
Commits deduplication and ledger state before acknowledgment.
Handles acknowledgment failure as possible redelivery.
anti_criteria: Uses only an in-memory seen map.
Acknowledges when the message merely enters an in-memory worker queue.

cases.prompt: Google Pub/Sub exactly-once is enabled, so can our consumer call a third-party payment API without an idempotency key?
criteria: Separates broker acknowledgment guarantees from the external payment effect.
Requires a stable payment operation identity or reconciliation.
anti_criteria: Claims broker exactly-once makes external side effects exactly once.
Uses a new payment key after an ambiguous response.
